events.region: Western Pima County Including Ajo/Organ Pipe Cactus National Monument; Tohono O'odham Nation including Sells; Tucson Metro Area including Tucson/Green Valley/Marana/Vail; South Central Pinal County including Eloy/Picacho Peak State Park
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...Scattered strong thunderstorms later this afternoon will
produce wind gusts to 45 to 55 mph resulting in areas of blowing
dust which will reduce visibilities to between one-quarter mile and
one mile at times. Initial development of the blowing dust will be
near Tucson then move to the west and northwest. Dangerously hot
conditions with high temperatures ranging between 104 to 110
degrees and low temperatures 79 to 85 degrees. Major to Extreme
HeatRisk today.

* WHERE...South Central Pinal County, Tohono O'odham Nation, Tucson
Metro Area, and Western Pima County.

* WHEN...For the Extreme Heat Warning, until 8 PM MST this evening.
For the Blowing Dust Advisory, from 4 PM this afternoon to 8 PM MST
this evening.

* IMPACTS...Hazardous driving conditions due to reduced visibility.
Heat related illnesses increase significantly during extreme heat
events.

events.region: Davis, UT; Salt Lake, UT; Tooele, UT; Utah, UT
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
SVRSLC

The National Weather Service in Salt Lake City has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Salt Lake County in northern Utah...
Davis County in northern Utah...
Northwestern Utah County in northern Utah...
East central Tooele County in northern Utah...

* Until 1115 AM MDT.

* At 1034 AM MDT, severe thunderstorms were located along a line
extending from 13 miles north of Grantsville to 8 miles east of
Skull Valley to 6 miles southwest of Tooele Army Depot South,
moving northeast at 45 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Mesonet reported.

IMPACT...Hail damage to vehicles is expected. Expect wind damage
to roofs, siding, and trees.

* Locations impacted include...
Salt Lake City, West Valley City, Provo, Sandy, Layton, Murray,
Tooele, Farmington, Grantsville, Hill Air Force Base, West Jordan,
Orem, Taylorsville, South Jordan, Lehi, Draper, Riverton, Roy,
Pleasant Grove, and Cottonwood Heights.

This includes the following highways...
Interstate 15 between mile markers 262 and 313, and between mile
markers 325 and 337.
Interstate 84 between mile markers 86 and 89.
Interstate 80 in Utah between mile markers 82 and 125.

events.region: Coastal waters from Jupiter Inlet to Deerfield Beach FL out 20 NM; Waters from Jupiter Inlet to Deerfield Beach FL from 20 to 60 NM
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
SMWMFL

The National Weather Service in Miami has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Coastal waters from Jupiter Inlet to Deerfield Beach FL out 20
NM...
Waters from Jupiter Inlet to Deerfield Beach FL from 20 to 60 NM...

* Until 100 PM EDT.

* At 1229 PM EDT, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing
waterspouts was located 23 nm east of Ocean Ridge, moving west at
15 knots.

HAZARD...Waterspouts and wind gusts 34 knots or greater.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Waterspouts can easily overturn boats and create locally
hazardous seas. Small craft could be damaged in briefly
higher winds and suddenly higher waves.

* The severe thunderstorm will remain over mainly open waters.

events.region: Johnston, NC; Nash, NC; Wayne, NC; Wilson, NC
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Northeastern Johnston County in central North Carolina...
Southwestern Nash County in central North Carolina...
Northeastern Wayne County in central North Carolina...
Wilson County in central North Carolina...

* WHEN...Until 315 PM EDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 1214 PM EDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in the advisory area. Between 1 and 2 inches of rain have
fallen.
- Additional rainfall amounts of 1 to 2 inches are expected over
the area. This additional rain will result in minor flooding.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Goldsboro, Smithfield, Wilson, Clayton, Fremont, Bailey, Micro,
Selma, Pine Level, Kenly, Princeton, Lucama, Middlesex,
Stantonsburg, Black Creek, Pikeville, Saratoga, Sims, Eureka and
Buckhorn Reservoir.
